transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Um, I guess what brings me in is that for the past few weeks, my eating has just been really off. I'll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without even meaning to, and then I just kind of pick at dinner, even when my wife cooks. I've noticed my jeans are starting to feel pretty loose, so... I figured I should probably come in and talk to someone about it.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah, I have. Um... most days lately, I just wake up with this heavy, flat feeling. It's like the apartment is just too quiet, and... well, usually I like to play music, but even picking up my guitar doesn’t really lift me right now. So, yeah, I've definitely been feeling pretty down.
Have you been intentionally eating less because you’re afraid of gaining weight or concerned about your body shape?
No, no, it's nothing like that. I'm not worried about gaining weight or how I look at all. I just... I really just don't have any appetite right now. It's definitely not on purpose.
About how much weight have you lost since this began?
I'm not exactly sure, to be honest. I haven't stepped on a scale or anything. I just know my clothes aren't fitting the same as they were a few weeks ago.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah, like I was saying earlier about my guitar. I just... I don't really have any desire to play it right now, and it doesn't really do anything for me when I try. So, yeah, I'd say so.
Have you measured your weight recently, or do you know approximately how much weight you have lost?

I think we just covered that, actually. Like I mentioned a minute ago, I haven't weighed myself or stepped on a scale recently. So I really don't know the exact amount, just that my clothes are fitting looser.
How long have you been feeling this depressed?
Um, I'd say this current low stretch has been going on for about three weeks. Yeah, about three weeks. It basically started right after my wife settled into her full-time work schedule.
How has your energy been over the past three weeks?
My energy? Um, it's just been really low. I feel pretty drained most days. It's hard to get motivated to do much of anything, honestly. I just feel tired a lot of the time.
How has your sleep been over the past three weeks?

I am sleeping, but it's been pretty broken up. I usually wake up around four or five in the morning, just thinking about bills or some of my unfinished tracks. So, I end up feeling tired before the day even really starts.
Have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead or of harming yourself?
No, I haven't. Um, even with feeling as down as I have been lately, I haven't had any thoughts about hurting myself or wanting to die. Nothing like that.
How much have these symptoms interfered with your ability to manage work, household responsibilities, or relationships?

I mean, I'm still keeping up with the basic things around the house. But my projects have pretty much stalled out. Like, I had reached out to some musicians recently, but I've been missing chances to actually follow through with them. So it's definitely getting in the way of that stuff.
How has your ability to concentrate been over the past three weeks?

It hasn't been great, honestly. Um, when I try to work on some code or arrange a song, I just... I keep rereading the exact same line. Or I'll replay the same eight bars of music over and over, and I still can’t decide what to do next. It's just really hard to focus and actually move forward with it.
